package shapes

type Base struct {
	ID int
}

func (b Base) Describe() int { return b.ID }

type Circle struct {
	Base
	Radius float64
}

func (c *Circle) Grow(by float64) *Circle {
	c.Radius += by
	return c
}

func (Circle) Kind() string { return "circle" }

func (c Circle) Area() float64 {
	return 3.14 * c.Radius * c.Radius
}
